name: PRID
description: A unique identifier for each soil profile or sample in the dataset.

name: HONU
description: A variable representing the horizon number within a soil profile, indicating the sequence of soil layers.

name: HBUP
description: The upper boundary depth of a specific soil horizon, measured in centimeters from the soil surface.

name: HBDE
description: The lower boundary depth of a specific soil horizon, measured in centimeters from the soil surface.

name: DIAH
description: The diameter of soil aggregates or particles, typically measured in millimeters.

name: DIAP
description: The diameter of soil pores, which may influence water movement and retention in the soil.

name: HODE
description: The organic matter content of the soil, often expressed as a percentage or weight fraction.

name: SCMO
description: Soil moisture content, typically measured as a percentage of the soil's total weight.

name: SCDR
description: Soil drainage class, indicating the natural drainage characteristics of the soil.

name: STTY
description: Soil texture type, which classifies the soil based on the relative proportions of sand, silt, and clay.

name: MINA
description: The mineral content of the soil, potentially expressed as a percentage or weight fraction.

name: SDTO
description: Soil density, typically measured in grams per cubic centimeter.

name: STPC
description: Soil texture percentage composition, detailing the proportions of various particle sizes.

name: CLPC
description: Clay percentage in the soil, indicating the proportion of clay-sized particles.

name: PSCL
description: The presence or concentration of specific soil minerals or chemical elements.

name: PHAQ
description: Soil pH level, indicating the acidity or alkalinity of the soil.

name: PHKC
element: pH of 1:5 soil/1M potassium chloride extract - direct (without stirring during measurement)
description: Potassium concentration in the soil, typically measured in milligrams per kilogram.

name: ELCO
description: The electrical conductivity of the soil, which may indicate salinity levels.

name: EXCA
description: Exchangeable cations in the soil, which are positively charged ions available for plant uptake.

name: EXMG
description: Magnesium concentration in the soil, typically measured in milligrams per kilogram.

name: EXNA
description: Sodium concentration in the soil, typically measured in milligrams per kilogram.

name: EXCK
description: Calcium concentration in the soil, typically measured in milligrams per kilogram.

name: EXAL
description: Aluminum concentration in the soil, typically measured in milligrams per kilogram.

name: EXAC
description: Acidity levels in the soil, often expressed in terms of pH or as a concentration of hydrogen ions.

name: CECS
description: Cation exchange capacity of the soil, indicating the soil's ability to hold and exchange cations.

name: TOTC
description: Total organic carbon content in the soil, typically expressed as a percentage or weight fraction.

name: TOTN
description: Total nitrogen content in the soil, typically expressed as a percentage or weight fraction.

name: TCEQ
description: Total carbon equivalent, which may relate to the overall carbon storage capacity of the soil.

name: GYPS
description: Gypsum content in the soil, typically measured as a percentage or weight fraction.

name: BULK
description: Bulk density of the soil, typically measured in grams per cubic centimeter.

name: WR17
description: Water retention capacity of the soil at a specific depth, potentially measured in centimeters.

name: WR20
description: Water retention capacity of the soil at a different specific depth, potentially measured in centimeters.

name: WR25
description: Water retention capacity of the soil at another specific depth, potentially measured in centimeters.

name: WR37
description: Water retention capacity of the soil at yet another specific depth, potentially measured in centimeters.

name: WR42
description: Water retention capacity of the soil at an additional specific depth, potentially measured in centimeters.

name: LATI
description: Latitude of the soil sampling location, measured in degrees.

name: LNGI
description: Longitude of the soil sampling location, measured in degrees.

name: LABO
description: Laboratory code or identifier associated with the soil analysis.

name: ELEV
description: Elevation of the soil sampling location, typically measured in meters above sea level.
